name: List under a heading
about: A short line ending in a colon over a list ("Three Warnings:" and a numbered list) is one Points passage, the line its small heading without the colon; with no theme the heading leads the slide. The numbers live in the list, not the words. Words in parentheses go to the notes.

runs.text: “Don’t forget Me when you experience prosperity” (vs. 12)
Don’t fall for the surrounding culture’s idols (vs. 14)
Don’t test God when hardship comes (vs. 16)
What is it about prosperity that can cause us to forget God?
